questions.stem: Which statement immediately exits a loop?
questions.solution: break terminates the nearest loop or switch.

questions.stem: What is the index of the first element of a C++ array?
How many times does a while loop execute when its condition is false initially?
questions.solution: while is a pretest loop; a false condition skips the body.

questions.stem: Which structure chooses between two alternative paths?
Which declaration creates a floating-point variable named price?
questions.solution: float is used for real numbers.

questions.stem: Which values can a bool variable hold?
questions.solution: A bool holds true or false.

questions.stem: Which term describes a finite sequence of precise steps that solves a problem?
questions.solution: An algorithm is a finite, ordered set of unambiguous steps.

questions.stem: Which item is NOT a programming paradigm?
questions.solution: Debugging is an activity, not a programming paradigm.

questions.stem: Which identifier is valid in C++?
questions.solution: An identifier may contain letters, digits and underscores, but cannot start with a digit or be a keyword.

questions.stem: Which input pattern stops when the user enters -1?
questions.solution: A sentinel value ends the loop.

questions.stem: This question tests programming concepts and error terminology.

parts.answer: A compiler translates the whole source program before execution; an interpreter translates and executes one statement at a time.
parts.solution: Award 1 mark for each correct definition.
parts.label: a

parts.text: State THREE differences between a compiler and an interpreter.
parts.answer: Compiler: whole program, produces object code, reports errors after compilation. Interpreter: statement by statement, no object file, stops at the first error; generally slower execution.
parts.solution: Award 1 mark for each valid difference.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: A program reads three integer values and displays the largest value.

parts.text: Draw a flowchart to find the largest of three values.
parts.answer: Start -> read a, b, c -> largest = a -> if b > largest then largest = b -> if c > largest then largest = c -> display largest -> end.
parts.solution: Award marks for input, initial assumption, two comparisons, output and flow.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write pseudocode and a complete C++ program for the flowchart.
parts.answer: Use if statements to update largest, then cout the result.
parts.solution: Award marks for correct comparisons, variable updates and output.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: This question tests declarations, constants and expressions.

parts.text: Write C++ declarations for: an integer age, a double price, a constant discount rate of 0.10 and a character grade.
parts.answer: int age; double price; const double DISCOUNT = 0.10; char grade;
parts.solution: Award marks for correct types, names and const initialisation.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write C++ statements to read age and price, calculate price after discount, and display the result.
parts.answer: cin >> age >> price; price = price - price * DISCOUNT; cout << price;
parts.solution: Award marks for input, discount expression and output.
parts.label: b

parts.text: Trace the program and state the output.

parts.text: Rewrite the segment using a do...while loop that sums only values greater than 5.
parts.answer: int i=0,s=0; do { if(a[i]>5) s+=a[i]; i++; } while(i<5); cout<<s;
parts.solution: Award marks for do...while, condition, filter and output.

questions.stem: A class records ten student marks in an array.

parts.text: Declare an integer array of ten marks and read the marks from the user.
parts.answer: int marks[10]; for(int i=0;i<10;i++) cin >> marks[i];
parts.solution: Award marks for array declaration, loop and input.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write a program segment to calculate and display the average, highest mark and number of marks above the average.
parts.answer: Compute total and highest in one loop; average = double(total)/10; then second loop counts marks > average.
parts.solution: Award marks for total, average, highest, second loop and output.
parts.label: b
